thread.title: Apple Updates MacBook Pro With Faster Performance, New Pro Features

title: Apple Updates MacBook Pro With Faster Performance, New Pro Features
text:
Shutterstock photo
(RTTNews.com) - Apple ( AAPL ) unveiled new MacBook Pro models with Touch Bar feature 8th-generation Intel Core processors, with 6-core on the 15-inch model for up to 70 percent faster performance and quad-core on the 13-inch model for up to two times faster performance. Additional updates include support for up to 32GB of memory, a True Tone display and an improved third-generation keyboard for quieter typing.
Starting at $1,799 and $2,399 respectively, the updated 13-inch MacBook Pro models with Touch Bar and 15-inch MacBook Pro models with Touch Bar are available immediately through Apple.com and in select Apple retail stores and Apple Authorized Resellers later in the current week.
Read the original article on RTTNews ( http://www.rttnews.com/2913202/apple-updates-macbook-pro-with-faster-performance-new-pro-features.aspx )
